answer: In PoA, every identity posts bonded collateral and signs protocol messages, allowing evidence to correlate equivocation through shared timing, keys, and control behavior. Penalties for k coordinated identities scale quadratically, O(k^2), so cooperation becomes progressively more expensive. Once detected, a sybil swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss, asymmetrically depleting escrows; a tide of aliases cannot shield a cipher or plume of colluding agents.
